title: TOP 10 Pharma Packaging Machinery Manufacturers In 2026
content: Professional supplier of overall solutions for pharmaceutical manufacturing and packaging. Syntegon Technology is a **company near Stuttgart, Germany.** It’s known for making pharma packaging machines. Then, it changed its name to **Syntegon.** This change let Syntegon focus just on packaging machines for **medicine and food.**. The main goal was to make packaging smooth for drug makers. For over fifty years, Syntegon has made many kinds of pharma packaging machines. These machines handle everything from making the product to putting it in its final package. Syntegon offers many machines for **solid pills and liquid medicines.** For solid drugs, they have **advanced capsule fillers.** These fillers can handle different capsule sizes very well. For liquid medicines, Syntegon has **up-to-date filling and closing machines.** These machines work with vials, bottles, and syringes. It’s very important that their machines can package products in a completely clean, or sterile, way. This gives drug makers the tech to keep products clean during packaging.
